newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Formulab shares continue to rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Formulab shares continue to rise.

text.p: The shares of computer software group Formulab Neuronetics Corp Ltd continued on Monday their stunning rise since the start of November with the stock rising another seven percent on high turnover by late trading.
At 3.40 p.m. (0440 GMT), Formulab shares were seven cents higher at A$1.06 after earlier touching a record high of A$1.10.
Turnover was about 4.38 million shares worth about 4.9 percent of the company's issued capital.
Since the start of November, Formulab stock has risen about 80 percent from its close of 59 cents on October 31.
Last Monday, Formulab told the Australian Stock Exchange it knew of no reason for the recent rise in its share price.

In mid-October, Formulab said its joint venture company with Goldtron Ltd had signed a memorandum of understanding with Siemens AG to develop an Internet server logic card, based on Formulab's Neuronetic technology.
In August Formulab said it planned to list its stock on the NASDAQ market and had appointed Bank of New York as manager of its American Depository Receipts (ADR) programme.
